name: SLR-Bench
description: SLR-Bench is a benchmarking collection for sign-language recognition/translation tasks that aggregates video-based corpora and evaluation protocols to compare models on recognition (gloss/labeling) and translation to text. It provides standardized splits and metrics to evaluate both classification-style recognition and sequence-to-sequence translation from sign video inputs. The benchmark is intended to facilitate development of robust sign-language understanding systems across datasets.
evaluation_method: accuracy for recognition; BLEU (or ROUGE) for translation; sometimes WER depending on setup
typical_sota_score: varies by subtask and dataset; recognition often in the ~50–90% range depending on dataset, translation typically much lower (BLEU 10–40)
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark within the sign-language research community with modest adoption and growing attention as multimodal models improve.
